extra.reason: Fixed: webhook handler now uses mapping.Pubkey (hex) for all 'p' tags and builds 'a' coordinates as 30617:<hex>:<repo-id> via new repoAddr() helper. Covered by new regression tests (TestNoNpubInSemanticTags, TestPR/Issue_*).
Fixed alongside phase1-9gl: PR and issue status events (1630-1633) now include the repo 'a' coordinate tag. Guarded by TestPR_OpenedEmitsHexTaggedEvents.

Added internal/webhook/handler_test.go: 8 tests covering HMAC accept/reject, method-not-allowed, push delegation+CI hook, unknown-repo no-op, PR opened/merged, issue opened/labeled, and hex-tag regression guards. Introduced Publisher interface for testability.
Fixed in this session: added err checks before resp.Body.Close() in nip55handler_test.go; go vet ./... is now clean.

Recovery complete: re-imported 48 issues from git HEAD:.beads/issues.jsonl into the empty Dolt backend; added embeddeddolt/, backup/, dolt-server.* and export-state.json to .beads/.gitignore so runtime artifacts stay untracked; bd export writes issues.jsonl for git-tracked history.

Implemented: handlePatchPush now (1) validates the refs/nostr/<id> is a 64-hex event id, (2) best-effort fetches the referenced kind:1617 patch via new publisher.FetchEvent (relay QuerySync), and (3) publishes a kind:1631 applied status with e=<patch-id>, a=30617:<hex>:<repo>, p=maintainer(+patch author when resolved), and applied-as-commits=<pushed SHA>. Emission is resilient to fetch failure/propagation lag since the git ref push is authoritative. Note: the bridge intentionally does NOT synthesize+sign a kind:1617 when absent — that would misattribute contributor authorship to the bridge key; the applied-status carries the landed commit instead. Tests: 4 webhook patch-push tests + publisher FetchEvent no-relay test.

Done: removed webhook.Handler.PublishAnnouncement (dead + semantically wrong — it would sign a kind:30617 with the BRIDGE key, misattributing the owner's repo announcement). Replaced with a comment documenting the correct model: the owner signs their 30617, the bridge caches it (provisioner.CacheAnnouncementEvent) and rebroadcasts it verbatim (publisher.republishAnnouncement). splitFullName was already removed in the prior commit.

Implemented and tested: webhook ingestion (HMAC + routing), BRIDGE_NSEC signing config, and publishToRelays/FetchEvent relay foundation all exist and are exercised by tests. Live multi-relay integration coverage tracked separately under epic-test-001.

Implemented: 30618 state-event construction (bridge-signed, correct hex tags, deterministic order) is now unit-tested with signature verification; 30617 owner-signed announcement rebroadcast is implemented via cache+republish. End-to-end live-relay republish integration test tracked under new issue.

Implemented via phase1-cwt: refs/nostr patch push now emits a NIP-34-compliant kind:1631 applied status referencing the patch (e), repo (a=30617:hex:repo), maintainer+author (p), and landed commit (applied-as-commits). Covered by 4 webhook patch-push tests + FetchEvent test.
Implemented + tested: handlePR emits 1618/1619 plus 1630-1633 status with valid hex tags and repo coordinate. Covered by TestPR_OpenedEmitsHexTaggedEvents and TestPR_MergedEmitsAppliedStatus.

Implemented + tested: handleIssue emits 1621 + status, labeled/unlabeled emits 1985 with hex 'p' and 30617:hex:repo 'a'. Covered by TestIssue_OpenedEmitsHexTaggedEvents and TestIssue_LabeledEmitsNIP32Label.

Done: added internal/publisher/integration_test.go using an in-process fiatjaf/khatru relay. Proves (1) RepublishForGiteaRepo publishes exactly one signature-valid kind:30618 on ref change with correct d/p/HEAD/branch/tag tags + store recording; (2) unchanged digest publishes nothing; (3) cached owner-signed 30617 rebroadcast verbatim (id/pubkey/sig/tags preserved) + LastRepublishedAnnouncementID updated; (4) FetchEvent round-trips by id. No production code changed. Full suite + vet green.

Publisher regression coverage now exists: unit tests (buildStateEvent signed/structured, FetchEvent) + integration tests (khatru relay: state publish/skip, announcement rebroadcast, FetchEvent round-trip). Auth suites already present (auth package green). Gate satisfied.

All children resolved: publish-001..005 implemented+tested (webhook ingestion, signing, 30617/30618, patch 1631, PR/issue/label). publish-006 resolved as Path B (bridge must not mint user 10317; guardrail+design doc; owner-signed rebroadcast deferred to phase1-kyg). NIP-34 outbound publishing is real and tested.

Coverage gaps closed: bridge bootstrap/config (test-001/002/003) + auth and publisher regression suites (test-004) done. Publisher now has unit + khatru integration coverage; webhook has a full handler suite.

Embedded relay now accepts collaboration events (1617/1618/1619/1621/1630-1633/1111) referencing a hosted repo (a=30617:pk:id via mapping store) or stored issue/patch/PR (e/E); rejects unrelated. Tested. cmd/grasp-bridge/embedded_full.go
Provisioner rejects 30617 announcements missing this service in the relays tag (hasRelayForService vs HookRelayURL), bypassed by GRASP05_ARCHIVE_MODE. Tested.
Embedded relay NIP-11 advertises supported_grasps ([GRASP-01,GRASP-02]), repo_acceptance_criteria, and curation (when curated). Tested.

New internal/refsnostr reaper: records refs/nostr/<id> pushes (pending_nostr_refs), rejects differing-tip, deletes refs after 20m with no matching 1618/1619 c-tag PR (gitea.DeleteBareRef); injectable clock/relay/deleter; wired in main.go. Tested.
deploy/nginx/gitea-vhost.conf.example sets fixed git-HTTP CORS (*, GET/POST, Content-Type) + OPTIONS 204 on info/refs, upload-pack, receive-pack.
deploy/gitea/app.ini.phase3.snippet enables uploadpack.allowFilter + allowAnySHA1InWant, with operator notes for literal allow-tip/allow-reachable-sha1-in-want per-repo flags.

proactivesync now runs a ticker (default 1h, clamped <=1h via NormalizeSyncInterval): each tick lists mappings, validates the cached owner-signed announcement, backfills historic state/PR events from the announcement relays (paged Until), git-fetches missing state objects from the clone URLs, and reconciles refs. Injectable ticker/gitRunner/relay for deterministic tests. Wired in main.go.

Same proactivesync tick queries announcement relays for accepted 1618/1619 PR events referencing the repo 'a' coordinate and fetches each PR 'c' tip from its clone tag into refs/nostr/<event-id> (>=hourly). Consistent with the refsnostr reaper (PR-backed refs are not reaped). Tested.

Bridge-side git smart-HTTP reverse proxy (internal/api/githttp_npub.go): matches /<npub>/<percent-encoded-id>.git/{info/refs,git-upload-pack,git-receive-pack}, looks up (npub,repo-id) in the store -> Gitea owner/repo, and streams via httputil.ReverseProxy to GITEA_URL rewritten to /<org>/<repo>.git/...; 404 on unknown, OPTIONS 204, fixed GRASP-01 CORS. EscapedPath preserves encoded slashes; identifier percent-decoded. Deploy note added: route public npub .git paths to the bridge. Tested.

All GRASP compliance children resolved: GRASP-01 relay accept policy (#3), relays-tag rejection (#2), NIP-11 (#4), refs/nostr lifecycle (#8), CORS (#10), upload-pack flags (#9), npub git-HTTP path (#5); GRASP-02 periodic git-data sync + PR refs/nostr fetch. See docs/reviews/grasp-compliance-audit.md.

Phase A done: internal/signer with encrypted signer_grants storage (nacl/secretbox, SIGNER_MASTER_KEY), CreateGrant (ConnectBunker+GetPublicKey verify), BunkerClient pool (lazy reconnect+Ping), SignWithGrant, BunkerSigner interface for tests. Wired (constructed) in main.go. Gate green incl -tags full.

Phase B done: internal/outbox persistent signing queue — outbound_events table (dedupe UNIQUE, lease claim), worker with backoff+dead-letter+idempotent publish, metrics + GET /outbound-events admin endpoint, publisher.PublishSigned, wired in main.go. 4 deterministic tests vs real store (success/idempotent, dedup, retry->dead, publish-fail retry). Gate green incl -tags full.

Phase C done: 30618 repo state now built unsigned/owner-authored and enqueued to the outbox for owner-grant signing (dedupe repo-state:<id>:<digest>); bridge-signed fallback + metric when signer disabled/no grant. POST /signer/authorize creates owner grants. 5401/30617 unchanged. Tests + gate green incl -tags full.

Phase D done: NIP-46 login persists reusable signer grant + identity link; webhook collaboration events (PR/issue/status/label/patch-applied) enqueue unsigned events authored by the acting contributor via publishActorEvent. Three-branch fallback: signer-disabled=legacy bridge-sign; linked+grant=enqueue; unlinked=skip+metric (never bridge-sign user content). Tests + gate green.

Phase E done: emitted 1617/1618/1619/1621/1630-1633 now match nips/34.md (subject not title, euc r, c/clone/branch-name on PR, E/P on 1619 which is tip-only, status e-markers + applied-as-commits/merge-commit); NIP-22 1111 comments via new issue_comment handler; euc computed via rev-list --max-parents=0. Tests + gate green.

Phase F done: internal/reflector ingests sig-verified collaboration events for provisioned repos and reflects 1621->Gitea issue, 1111->comment, 1630/1632->issue state; subscriber expanded to collaboration kinds; gitea client CreateIssue/CreateIssueComment/SetIssueState; echo-loop prevention via reflected_events + one-shot webhook guard; patch full-apply deferred (documented). Tests + gate green.

Owner-signed 10317 cache+rebroadcast: ingest (sig-verified, owner-only) -> user_grasp_list table (replaceable by created_at) -> verbatim rebroadcast (id/pubkey/sig preserved) + last_republished_id. Mint guardrail retained. Tests + gate green.

Phase G docs: README + nip34-webhook-implementation rewritten to user-signed model; new docs/user-signed-operations.md runbook; .env.example documents SIGNER_MASTER_KEY/PROACTIVE_SYNC_INTERVAL/GRASP05_ARCHIVE_MODE + legacy mode; limitations documented (patch-apply, no pre-link backfill, maintainers owner-driven, historical events).

EPIC complete: user-signed NIP-46 migration + full NIP-34 compliance shipped. A signer foundation (encrypted grants + BunkerClient pool), B outbound signing queue, C owner-signed 30618, D contributor-signed collaboration events (queue-until-linked), E NIP-34 tag-schema compliance + NIP-22 1111 + euc, F Nostr->Gitea reflection w/ echo-loop prevention, G docs; plus 10317 owner cache/rebroadcast. Transition fallbacks keep legacy bridge-signed mode when SIGNER_MASTER_KEY unset. Documented deferrals: full patch-apply, pre-link backfill.

Implemented: reflector opens a Gitea PR from Nostr 1617/1618 via two paths — (1) fetch c-tip into refs/nostr/<id> -> head branch (git update-ref) -> resolve base from bare-repo HEAD -> CreatePullRequest; (2) content format-patch -> temp detached worktree + git am -> head branch -> PR. Graceful fallback to recordPatchOnly + worktree cleanup on any failure; branch-name safety vs base; records KindPROpen for echo guard; handlePR skips reflected PR webhooks. 1619 update deferred. gitea CreatePullRequest added; 1618 subscribed. Tests + gate green incl -tags full.

1619 PR-update reflection: reflected_events.gitea_head_branch persists the PR head at create; reflectPRUpdate resolves root via NIP-22 E tag -> reflected KindPROpen row, validates c tip, fetches it, force-updates refs/heads/<HeadBranch>, records KindPRUpdate (echo guard); handlePR skips reflected synchronized events. Gitea branch-sync caveat documented. Tests + gate green incl -tags full.

Echo guard hardened: internal/echofp per-kind fingerprints; reflected_events.echo_armed_at+echo_fingerprint; CheckReflectedGiteaEcho is windowed (5m), fingerprint-matched, NON-consuming (duplicate-safe) with lazy DisarmExpiredEchoGuards (dropped-safe); webhook+reflector compute matching fingerprints. Tests cover duplicate/dropped/mismatch/expiry. Gate green.

Pre-link backfill: unlinked-actor events persisted to pending_actor_events (keyed by gitea_user_id, capped 500/user + 30d, dedupe idempotent) instead of dropped; NIP-46 login triggers ActorBackfiller.EnqueuePending which sets PubKey=linked pubkey and enqueues each pending event to the outbox then deletes the row. Metric actor_events_backfilled. Tests + gate green incl -tags full.
